title: Straight from Putin's playbook: Turkey's Islamists are jailing LGBTQ activists in ‘morality’ drive
gist: Podcast episode page: Turkish LGBTQ activist Yildiz Tar argues Turkey's government is escalating repression of LGBTQ people in a 'morality' drive modeled on Putin's playbook, primarily to divert attention from soaring inflation, poverty and joblessness.

insights.claim: Turkish LGBTQ activist Yildiz Tar argues the government's escalating crackdown on the LGBTQ community is less about public morals than an effort to divert attention from soaring inflation, poverty and joblessness.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Culture-war escalation can be a tell of domestic economic stress; read it alongside Turkish inflation and unemployment data.
insights.quote: The crackdown has less to do with public morals than an effort to divert public attention away from soaring inflation, poverty and joblessness
insights.locator: Leading Turkish LGBTQ activist Yildiz Tar

insights.claim: Turkey's Islamist-led government is jailing LGBTQ activists in a 'morality' drive framed as following Putin's playbook.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Rising authoritarian drift adds governance and rule-of-law risk to Turkish assets and EU relations.
